note: Desired public surface for every public repo on peebee1. state is the source of truth; tools/repo_meta.py validates it, --live compares it to GitHub, --apply writes it. Private repos are out of scope: the point is discovery by a stranger, and a private repo is not discovered.

repos.description: Daily, tested artifacts on AI native fintech infrastructure. Each one ships with code, deterministic tests, and a number produced by the committed code.
Settlement reconciliation that scores its own recall against injected breaks, never forces a match, and proves every line was accounted for exactly once.
One subscription, three rails. A scheduler policy simulator for card recurring, SEPA direct debit, and UPI autopay, with refund exposure counted apart from revenue.
Parth Batra, Product Group Lead at Klarna. Building agentic commerce and payments systems in the open, with the numbers attached.

Reference implementation of the Agentic Commerce Protocol (spec 2026-04-17): merchant checkout over REST and MCP, a mock PSP with delegated payments and 3DS, signed order webhooks, 39 conformance tests.
Ask for a product in plain English, get a ranked, reasoned shortlist. An agentic commerce demo: understand, retrieve, rank, with a trace.
Agent-to-agent price negotiation where every LLM judgment sits inside a typed protocol, with private guards, traces, and a reproducible eval harness.
Personal site for Mishika Gupta, strategy and business consultant.

An acquirer funds payouts at 11:00 and settles cards at 16:30, so the daily net says nothing about the buffer. A simulator that sizes it against the intraday requirement: USD 106,970 a year against USD 448,355 for holding nothing.

A chargeback runs on three clocks, not one. A simulator that scores dispute policies against an analyst budget: 21.3% of the recoverable value with a status tracker, 94.0% with the clocks, an evidence gate and a value per minute queue.
